envelope.description: One follow-up per completed turn-ended batch

body.title: One follow-up per completed turn-ended batch
body.summary: When a turn-ended batch is complete (its turn ended and every request decided), run exactly one follow-up via runTurn(prompt, grantChain, { suppressEcho: true }): one approved tool-gate uses today's exact prompt text ('Approved — run exactly this now: <command>' or the tool-name fallback); several use one combined prompt naming each approved action (exact command where captured) and each denied one; all denied (or only dir-blocks approved) posts an informational 'no action was approved' message and runs nothing. Requests the follow-up raises form the next batch; the grant chain carries over.
acceptanceChecks: Approving three turn-ended requests starts turns.start exactly once, after the last decision and the turn's end, with allowedTools = the three tools and a prompt naming the three actions
A denied request is named as denied in the combined follow-up; all denied runs no follow-up and posts the notice
A follow-up that is refused again forms a new batch whose follow-up carries the earlier grants
The existing single-request approve / deny / exact-command / tool-name / dir-block / suppressEcho tests pass unchanged

tests.name: approving all three starts exactly one follow-up turn, after the last decision and the turn's end, with allowedTools = all three tools and a prompt naming the three approved actions
no approval ever supersedes a running follow-up: turns.start is called once per batch
deny: a denied request gets a rejected chip, the next request is still asked, and the follow-up names it as denied; all denied -> no follow-up and an informational message
a follow-up that is refused again forms the next batch and its follow-up carries the previous batch's grants
single request: the existing approve/deny/exact-command/tool-name/dir-block/suppressEcho tests keep passing unchanged
